title: The Benefit Limit That Applies to the Head Decided
content:
The benefit limit that applies to a payment under the Travel Protection Plans follows the head the insurer
decided, which is the benefit named on the decision it allowed last and which awaits payment on the policy's
claim record.

## The four readings

| The head decided | The benefit limit that applies |
|---|---|
| A travel delay | The plan's travel delay benefit limit |
| A baggage delay | The plan's baggage delay benefit limit |
| An emergency medical treatment | The plan's emergency medical benefit limit for each insured traveller |
| Any other head | The declared trip cost standing on the certificate |

The three named heads each take the plan's own figure for that benefit; every other head the plans carry —
cancellation, interruption, dental treatment, evacuation, accidental death, baggage lost outright, a missed
connection, damage to a hired vehicle or a cancellation for any reason — takes the declared trip cost standing
on the certificate as its limit.

## A point of judgement

Where two decisions stand on one policy, one allowing a baggage delay head and a later one allowing an emergency
medical head, the limit that applies to the payment now being made is the plan's emergency medical benefit limit
for each insured traveller, because the head decided is the one on the decision the insurer allowed last and
which awaits payment.
